services.title: Services
services.individualText: One-on-one sessions focused on what you're carrying — anxiety, stress, relationships, identity, or simply needing space to think out loud.
services.couplesText: A supported space for two people to understand each other better and work through what's between you.
services.durationNote: Sessions run 50 minutes unless otherwise agreed.
services.formatChatText: Real-time text conversation during your session.
services.formatAsyncText: Exchange messages within an agreed window — no need to be online at the same time.
services.firstSessionText: There's no need to prepare anything. The first session is about getting to know each other — what brought you here, what you're hoping for, and whether this feels like the right fit for you. You're welcome to share as much or as little as you're comfortable with.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.q1q: What happens in the first session?
faqPage.q1a: We'll spend the first session getting to know each other — what brought you here, what you're hoping to work through, and how you like to communicate. There's no pressure to share everything right away.
faqPage.q2q: How much does a session cost?
faqPage.q2a: Individual sessions are [price], and couples sessions are [price]. Payment is currently handled directly — details are shared when you book.
faqPage.q3a: Yes. Everything discussed in session is kept strictly confidential, with the only exceptions being situations required by law, such as an immediate risk of harm to yourself or someone else.
faqPage.q4q: Can I choose between video, chat, or messaging?
faqPage.q4a: Yes — you choose the format that feels most comfortable when you book, and you're welcome to switch formats between sessions.
faqPage.q5q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
faqPage.q5a: Every confirmation email includes a link where you can cancel your session yourself. If you'd like to reschedule instead of cancelling, just book a new time after cancelling the old one.
faqPage.q6q: Do you offer sessions in both Albanian and English?
faqPage.q6a: Yes, sessions are available in both languages — just mention your preference when you book.
faqPage.q7q: How do I know if therapy is right for me?
faqPage.q7a: If you're asking the question, it's usually worth a first session to find out. There's no commitment beyond that — many people book one session just to see how it feels.
faqPage.q8q: What if I'm not sure this is the right fit?
faqPage.q8a: That's completely normal, and it's something we can talk about openly. If another kind of support would serve you better, you'll be told honestly and, where possible, pointed in the right direction.
faqPage.crisisNoteText: This site is not for emergencies. If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency services right away.
